About

I’m a Strategy Director with over fourteen years of experience developing brand, campaign, and social strategies for some of the most recognizable names in fashion, sportswear, media, and more.

Originally from Portland, OR, I’ve made my way to New York via a spell in Washington, DC.

Outside of work I’m an avid soccer player, golfer, and all around outdoors person. I love to eat, drink, try new things, and travel the world.
